name: Non-syndromic Cerebral Malformation

criteria.description: Neuroimaging evidence of cerebral malformation without associated systemic anomalies
Lack of extracerebral malformations or syndromic features on clinical examination
Exclusion of known syndromic genetic mutations associated with cerebral malformations

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of neuroimaging-confirmed cerebral malformation with absence of syndromic features and exclusion of syndromic genetic causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies heavily on detailed neuroimaging and clinical evaluation to exclude syndromic involvement.

pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic localized malformation of cortical development
Abnormal cortical layering with excessive small gyri

common.notes: Delayed acquisition of motor and cognitive milestones
Recurrent seizures often focal in origin

occasional.notes: Localized visual impairment related to cortical involvement

rare.notes: Ventricular enlargement secondary to impaired CSF flow
Autistic features or hyperactivity occasionally reported

imaging: MRI showing focal cortical dysplasia, polymicrogyria, or other cortical malformations
Absence of extracerebral structural anomalies on imaging
genetic: Negative for mutations in genes associated with syndromic cerebral malformations (e.g., LIS1, DCX)
Possible identification of isolated gene variants linked to cortical development
other: Normal systemic examination excluding syndromic involvement

distinguishingFeatures: Characteristic nodules of gray matter along lateral ventricles on MRI
Often associated with FLNA gene mutations
May present with seizures but distinct imaging pattern

redFlags: Presence of systemic malformations or dysmorphic features
Unexplained severe seizures refractory to treatment
references: Barkovich AJ et al. A developmental and genetic classification for malformations of cortical development. Neurology. 2012.
Guerrini R, Dobyns WB. Malformations of cortical development: clinical features and genetic causes. Lancet Neurol. 2014.
